description: This source file defines an Android activity that demonstrates an expandable list interface backed by Cursor data, particularly showing contacts and their phone numbers. It includes an inner class for asynchronous queries and a custom adapter for handling grouped data.

classes.name: ExpandableList2
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating an expandable list view with contacts and phone numbers, managing asynchronous data loading and a custom adapter.

classes.name: QueryHandler
classes.description: An inner class extending AsyncQueryHandler that handles asynchronous query completions to update the adapter with contact data.

classes.name: MyExpandableListAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter extending SimpleCursorTreeAdapter to provide children cursors (phone numbers) for each contact group, initiating background queries to load data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the adapter, and starts the initial contact query.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources by nullifying the adapter and closing cursors.
